record.original_question: Suppose that φ is an automorphism of a finite soluble group G, and let r be the(Prüfer) rank of the fixed-point subgroup CG(φ). Is the Fitting height of G bounded terms of |φ| and r? This is known to be true in the case where |φ| is a product of at most two prime powers(B. Hartley, Preprint, 1994, https://kourovkanotebookorg.wordpress. com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/hartley94-prepr-mims.pdf). An affirmative answer to this question would imply an affirmative answer to 13.8(b).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite soluble group and let $\varphi$ be an automorphism of $G$. Denote by $C_G(\varphi) = \{g \in G : \varphi(g) = g\}$ the fixed-point subgroup of $\varphi$, and let $r$ be the Prüfer rank of $C_G(\varphi)$ (that is, the smallest integer such that every finitely generated subgroup of $C_G(\varphi)$ can be generated by $r$ elements). Let $|\varphi|$ denote the order of $\varphi$ as an element of $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$, and let $h(G)$ denote the Fitting height of $G$ (the length of the shortest normal series of $G$ with nilpotent factors).

Question: Does there exist a function $f:\mathbb{N}\times\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that $h(G) \le f(|\varphi|, r)$ for every finite soluble group $G$ and every automorphism $\varphi$ of $G$?

It is known that the answer is affirmative whenever $|\varphi|$ is a product of at most two prime powers.
artifact.category_tag: finite soluble groups, automorphisms, Fitting height
artifact.status_search_result: A web search reveals related partial results bounding the Fitting height of finite soluble groups in terms of automorphism order and fixed-point data (e.g., Hartley's 1994 result for orders that are products of at most two prime powers, and various results bounding Fitting height when the fixed-point subgroup has bounded order or rank under additional hypotheses), but no result establishing the bound in full generality for arbitrary $|\varphi|$. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.snippet: Studies bounds on structure of finite groups admitting automorphisms with fixed-point subgroups of bounded rank.
status_evidence.claim: Related partial results exist bounding Fitting height under rank conditions on fixed-point subgroups.

status_evidence.title: Fitting height of finite groups admitting a fixed-point-free automorphism satisfying an additional polynomial identity
status_evidence.snippet: Bounds on Fitting height under fixed-point and additional algebraic constraints on automorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: The general question of bounding Fitting height in terms of |φ| and Prüfer rank of C_G(φ) is studied via partial cases.
